[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Euritarina''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working at the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotide]]. Euritarina was involved in weapons testing.
